mstts:express-as.prosody:
As we wrap up our time together, let’s bring everything back to the heart of Ama Dios.
This journey isn’t just for the saints or the sages. It’s an open invitation for you—for anyone, in any moment—to discover that deep well of love already living inside you, and let it flow out into the world around you.
The stories and practices we’ve touched on aren’t strict rules to follow. Think of them more like gentle reminders—little nudges showing you that the sacred can be found right in the middle of ordinary life, and that awakening is truly possible anytime, anywhere.
So, what does this all mean for you?
Forgiveness isn’t about fixing the past—it’s a gift you give yourself, right now.
Inner peace? It doesn’t depend on having everything just right. It’s something you find in presence, in simply being here.
And those small acts of service? They might seem tiny, but they send ripples farther than you can see.
Doubt will show up along the way, and that’s completely normal. It’s not a sign you’ve failed.
Surrender isn’t about giving up—it’s about trusting that there’s a deeper flow guiding you.
And this journey? It never really ends. You can always return to love—again and again—without judging yourself.
If you’re ever longing for more—more connection, more meaning, more peace—remember, you’re not alone. The wisdom of Ama Dios is simple, but powerful: love isn’t something you have to chase or earn. It’s already part of who you are.
Every day, you’re invited to turn inward, to listen, to trust, and to act from the quiet strength of your own heart. There will be times you’ll stumble, or forget, or feel lost. But there will also be moments of grace, of clarity, and a deep sense of belonging.
Let yourself move with that gentle current of love. Remind yourself: every step you take—no matter how small—is a step towards home.
The world truly needs your light, your kindness, your courage. So, why not begin right where you are, and let love show you the way forward?
